Acceptance document 4: a distinct local-only fixture sentence used to exercise repeatable data preparation. This file has unique terms 4 and deterministic content for tokenizer and shard validation.

Numerical computing systems must manage memory, execution time, and device capabilities carefully. Training workloads can allocate memory for model parameters, gradients, optimizer state, intermediate activations, and cached tensors. A reliable benchmark records the hardware configuration, software versions, batch dimensions, sequence length, throughput, and peak resource use. Small smoke tests can establish basic execution correctness, but they do not prove that a large training workload will fit within available memory.
